nom: Simplified Skin Rose Water Spray for Face & Hair

avis.texte: I have reordered these rose water sprays quite a few times- I use it for my face and hair and just when I want a little nice scent. It's important for me that these come in glass containers- I think their refill came in a plastic bottle...so I have been reordering this 3 set version instead. The spray head actually lasts the whole time which is kind of important to me. They package these really well- and although that may not matter to some, it has a beautiful presentation and I have gifted one of the 3 in the past. It was so well received! There may be some slight slight lot variation in scent but that is completely within range for me as it always smells fresh and natural as it should. This is one of my few staples that I always have.

avis.titre: Beautifully scented and refreshing!Beautifully scented and refreshing!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this organic rose water spray. The scent is one of my favorite things about it, fresh, delicate roses, like real roses, without that overpowering artificial fragrance that some rose products have. It feels light, clean, and very natural. The mist itself is fine and refreshing. It dries quickly on the skin and doesn’t leave any sticky or heavy residue behind. I’ve been using it as a facial toner and mid-day refresh, and it gives my skin a nice boost of hydration without feeling greasy. It’s especially nice after cleansing or when my skin needs a quick pick-me-up. I also appreciate that it’s alcohol-free and gentle. It feels soothing and calming, making it great for sensitive skin. The lightweight formula makes it easy to use throughout the day, and the spa-like scent turns a simple skincare step into a relaxing moment. Overall, this is a beautiful, multi-purpose rose water spray that feels high-quality and refreshing. If you love a soft, natural rose scent and a light hydrating mist, this is a great option.

avis.titre: Refreshing and gentle mist with a natural rose scentRefreshing and gentle mist with a natural rose scent
avis.texte: This rose water spray is very refreshing and easy to use throughout the day. The mist is fine and spreads evenly on the skin and hair without feeling heavy or sticky. It works well as a toner after cleansing, a makeup refresher, or a light hydration boost during dry weather. I like that it is made with organic rosewater and does not feel harsh on sensitive skin. The natural rose scent is light and pleasant, not overpowering. It also works nicely on hair and locs to add a bit of moisture and shine. For very dry skin, it works best when layered with a moisturizer afterward, since it is more of a refreshing mist than a deep hydrator. Overall, it is a versatile and gentle product for everyday skincare and hair care.

avis.titre: Fabulous Organic Rose Water Toner Spray For Face, Neck, Hair, And Scalp!
avis.texte: Update April 20, 2025: I continue to love this Organic Rose Water Toner for face, neck, scalp, and hair care. So soothing and refreshing. Ordered the 8 ounce refill, a terrific value! == Original Review: I have very sensitive skin, including my scalp. A delicate spray on toner is a must have in my daily skin and scalp care routine. Unfortunately, the toner I had been using was becoming too expensive for my budget. Thought I would give this USDA Certified Bulgarian Rosewater Facial Toner a try. So happy I did, this product is a keeper! Everything about it exceeded my expectations. - So versatile! Great for skin, scalp, and hair care. Apply a spritz over facial makeup to freshen up your day. - USDA Certified Organic. That's important to me. - The product has a soft rose fragrance that does not interfere with any perfume/fragrances I am wearing. - So soothing and refreshing! The price point is excellent and affordable and it works well with other products from the skincare line. Don't hesitate or second guess. Just try it.

avis.titre: What a beautiful, floral rose scent!
avis.texte: I am really enjoying this Rosewater and Glycerin Spray from Simplified Skin. Priced at under $13, I find this to be a great value as you only need 1-2 little spritzes per use. They recommend applying 3+ times a day, so I assume morning, evening, and anytime in-between. I don't think the container is meant to be portable though so I only use it in the morning after washing my face and before applying my moisturizer. I like that this is a spray application so I don't need to use a cotton pad, and it doesn't feel like I'm scrubbing my skin. The scent is so nice and pleasant, very rose without being overpowering. And yet the spray itself feels very gentle. It can also be used as a setting spray after applying makeup, which I don't normally do unless the weather is particularly warm.

Non-sticky, fast absorbing and no build-up/residue, very simple to use, yet effective. Great quality item with good, clean ingredients and infusions that help with the skin health. It is multi-purpose: both my wife and daughter use it also for hair and as a toner and they said it makes their make up smooth. Great value and exceeds expectations, which is not easy to do when it comes to my wife's skin care products! Buy it!

avis.titre: Moisturizing, Clean Ingredients. Not Just A Toner. LOVE IT!
avis.texte: If you want to keep your skin soft and hydrated, this will do it. It's not a simple toner. If you're anything like I am, you want to know everything about every product you use on your skin. I am now thoroughly into keeping my skin moisturized all day long. I assumed everyone knew what hyaluronic acid was until my neighbor told me she didn't want to put acid on her skin. Fyi - I told her that hyaluronic acid has the acidity (or pH) of our own skin (it's found in our skin), and it's a humectant/moisturizer! I also learned the hard way that if you use hyaluronic acid or sodium hyaluronate, it looks for water in the skin and binds with it - possibly holding 1,000 times its weight in water, but it can also evaporate. Well, I don't want it to bind with the water in my skin. It's already in my skin! I don't want it to evaporate either. So, I'd rather give it water, and it can bind to that! What an awesome product! This isn't just rose water. It's a super low molecular weight hyaluronic acid with beta glucan, panthenol and rose water. As soon as I've used a sodium hyaluronate or hyaluronic acid product, I spritz my face with water and minerals or botanicals, but I'll be using this. I then seal it all up with a nice moisturizer. It's made with simple ingredients that work and it doesn't hurt that it smells like roses. It's the perfect spray-moisturizer to bring with you wherever you go, to freshen up your makeup, and fight lines and wrinkles. Two full 4-ounce bottles, yes please!

I have loved the smell of rosewater and rose oil for decades. Finding skincare with rosewater always makes me happy. Sometimes you don't actually smell the rose scent in them, but this one is just perfect! It is also refreshing to your face, doing it's job as a toner, refresher spray at the same time as smelling like my favorite scent. It is a hydrating rosewater spray that can be used on your skin or on your hair! I didn't catch the hair part when I ordered it, but it has taught me that rosewater helps dry, frizzy strands, glycerin helps soften hair, and allantoin helps with a dry flaky scalp. The two in one was such a bonus, I thought I was just getting a skin toner! It has super low weight hyaluronic acid which penetrates the skin barrier well and makes it smoother and plumper. It also contains beta-glucan and panthenol. It has a short, simple ingredient list packed with powerhouses, but no alcohol, no sulfates, no dyes, or fragrance, made by a brand that is cruelty free. I'm a big fan of this one. It comes in a glass bottle, packed safety inside of a box that cradles it safely. The bottle comes with a cap on it and a seperate spray nozzle to add in after you have opened up the lid and seal. The glass bottle makes it look more high end that it is. I would not guess this was under thirteen dollars without seeing the price tag. It is an incredible value for 4oz of a spray that will last a long time. avis.titre: A loving, refreshing spritz between my cleanser and moisturizer
avis.texte: I'd never used a spray toner before because I was far too used to just dabbing some one a cotton ball and applying it between steps in my skincare routine, but I was very pleasantly surprised by this! The faint rose scent coupled with the cool spritz of toner, which I then dabbed in with a cotton pad, felt super refreshing right after a sturdy cleanse. I tend to scrub pretty hard to get off the makeup and grime of the day, so this felt amazing on my slightly irritated skin. It's a great midway step to then applying moisturizer afterwards, but this spray would definitely be great for just some on-the-spot hydration if you're going without makeup and just need a quick little pick-me-up during the day! The glass bottle seems very durable, and the spray nozzle attachment was a perfect accompaniment for this solution.

It’s gentle enough for my sensitive skin and works well as a hydrating step during the day or after cleansing. The bottle size makes it a good value too, especially considering how well it refreshes and softens the skin.
